verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs claim search and registration across over 600 domain extensions, plus IDN registration and multi-TLD bulk search, which covers the 'hundreds of extensions' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents per-TLD special requirements such as restricted TLDs or country-code eligibility rules. Missing for 10: per-TLD requirements documentation, explicit coverage of restricted and ccTLD extensions, independent corroboration of the TLD count.
